title: Arrest Of Indecent Picture Sellers

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 35m-11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File S/B. R. CL. Y.
No. D. 5789
S. 5.
Date 9 / 4 / 34
Date April 9, 1934.

Subject (in full) Arrest of Indecent Picture Sellers.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S. McKeown.

At 7 p.m. April 8 C.D.S. 96 arrested two indecent
picture sellers named Tseu Hai Veng (周海文) and Chiang
Yeu Zung (姜有存) at the corner of Hopei and Foochow Roads
and seized 250 copies of indecent pictures. The accused
were arraigned before the First Shanghai Special District
Court on the morning of April.9. They were sentenced to
30 days imprisonment.

J M Brown
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

15
CDS 96 seems
to be picking up
- Rest them at it.
Press to FILE
HR
noted
JMB SS.

G. 35m-11-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 S/B. R. CL. Y.
编号 D. 5789
S. 5.
日期 34年4月9日
日期 1934年4月9日。

事由（全称）逮捕贩卖淫秽图片者。

由警佐麦基文（D.S. McKeown）撰写并呈报。

4月8日晚7时，便衣警探第96号在河北路与福州路转角处逮捕了两名贩卖淫秽图片的男子，分别名为周海文（Tseu Hai Veng）和姜有存（Chiang Yeu Zung），并查获淫秽图片250张。被告于4月9日上午在上海第一特区地方法院受审。二人被判处监禁30天。

J M Brown
警佐

特别科科长。

15
便衣警探第96号似乎
抓人很勤快
——让他继续干。
归档
HR
已阅
JMB SS.
